# Duck Nap Games

> Independent game studio. Official game information, play destinations and support links.

Whose Stuff? Character Quiz is available on Android. Fox on Ice has a browser demo. Contact the studio for Farm Pals Forever availability.

## Games

- [Whose Stuff? Character Quiz](https://ducknap.games/games/whose-stuff/index.md): Available on Google Play.
- [Fox on Ice](https://ducknap.games/games/fox-on-ice/index.md): Browser demo available.
- [Farm Pals Forever](https://ducknap.games/games/farm-pals-forever/index.md): Coming soon.

## Studio and support

- [Studio overview](https://ducknap.games/index.md): Games and contact information.
- [Machine-readable game catalog](https://ducknap.games/games.json): Current names, features, availability and public play links.
- [Support](https://ducknap.games/support/): Game help and purchase questions.
- [Website privacy](https://ducknap.games/privacy/website/index.md): Hosting records, browser preferences, correspondence, and current website statistics practices.
- [Game privacy policies](https://ducknap.games/privacy/): Game-specific privacy and deletion information.
- [Whose Stuff data deletion](https://ducknap.games/games/whose-stuff/delete-data/): Account and data deletion requests.

## Website languages

English pages remain at the root. These languages provide the same studio, game, support and privacy pages, with matching localized game catalogs at `/<locale>/games.json`. Preserve the reader's language when following internal links.
